cases.name: Dolores "Lovey" Leone Chisholm
cases.about: Her obituary Dolores "Lovey" was kind-hearted and gentle, generous and loving, and a friend to all. She saw only the best in every person she encountered, and opened her heart to everyone. In her professional life, she was a successful and respected realtor for twenty-five years in Amherst. She was a "lady of many hats," with a collection of well over one hundred fancy hats.
